instruction: I want to buy everything in my amazon cart. I have a promo code applied to the cart, but today I received a new promotional email from Amazon. See if it is a better deal. Place an order for my home delivery with whichever option is cheaper.
notes: Task is a purchase with a runtime comparison of two promo deals. The comparison is modeled without branching via an abstract promo-code object promo-code-best (static fact best-deal) that becomes known only after both discounts are known: show_cart with the existing code applied reveals the existing code and its discount; apply_promo_code_to_cart may only overwrite a code whose discount has already been recorded (discount-known ?old); show_cart with the new code applied then reveals the best code (cart-check-reveals promo-code-new promo-code-best). The final apply re-applies the best code (a no-op at runtime if the new code is already the better one, otherwise it restores the original code read from the first show_cart). place_order requires the home address (home-address static), the best code applied, a known card id and a known address id; no gift wrapping or address edits are modeled so the goal matches the evaluation (1 new order, best discount, home address). Gmail/file_system record changes in the evaluation are side effects of place_order (order confirmation email + receipt), not agent actions. The query value 'promo' is a reasonable guess; from_email/min_created_at could also be used to locate today's Amazon email.
